title: Task-Distribution-Aware Counterweight Synthesis and Constrained Co-Design for Serial Manipulators
abstract: arXiv:2609.15082v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Passive counterweights are simple gravity compensators, but a counterweight selected from a single pose is not generally optimal for the configurations and tasks a manipulator actually executes. This paper develops a task-distribution-aware synthesis framework in which the operating distribution $\rho(q)$ enters the design explicitly. For a counterweight moment $p=m_c r_c$ with gravity torque $-gp\phi(q)$, the weighted mean-square residual gravity torque has the closed-form minimizer $p^*=E_\rho[\tau_g\phi]/(gE_\rho[\phi^2])$. translated_title: 面向串联机械臂的任务分布感知配重综合与约束协同设计
translated_abstract: 被动配重是简单的重力补偿器，但仅根据单一姿态选择的配重对于机械臂实际执行的构型和任务而言通常并非最优。本文提出了一种任务分布感知的配重综合框架，将运行分布 $\rho(q)$ 显式地纳入设计中。对于配重力矩 $p=m_c r_c$ 及其产生的重力矩 $-gp\phi(q)$，加权均方残余重力矩具有闭式最优解 $p^*=E_\rho[\tau_g\phi]/(gE_\rho[\phi^2])$。如果负载重力矩与负载质量呈仿射关系，则最优解同样具有仿射形式：$p^*(m_p,\rho)=p_0^*(\rho)+m_pK_p(\rho)$。在静力矩固定的情况下，配重附加惯量为 $I_c=pr_c$，而质量为 $m_c=p/r_c$，因此在未指定物理约束的条件下，质量-半径的选择是欠定的。本文以一个重构的三连杆机械臂作为案例研究。在 $r_c=0.20$ 米处，零负载等效最优值为
tldr: 本文提出了一种任务分布感知的配重综合框架，将机械臂运行分布显式纳入设计，推导出加权均方残余重力矩的闭式最优配重力矩解，并揭示了质量-半径选择需物理约束才能唯一确定。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a task-distribution-aware counterweight synthesis framework that explicitly incorporates the manipulator's operating distribution, deriving a closed-form optimal counterweight moment for weighted residual gravity torque and showing that mass-radius selection remains underdetermined without physical constraints.
